newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland seen removing tariff on microchips in March.
newsitem.headline: Poland seen removing tariff on microchips in March.

text.p: Poland is likely to remove the nine-percent customs duty on microprocessors imported from non-European countries in mid-March, an economy ministry official told the daily Gazeta Wyborcza on Wednesday.
The official, who declined to be named, said the draft regulation first needed the approval of the cabinet and its special economic committee (KERM).
The ministry on Wednesday declined to comment on the story.
The official also told Wyborcza that the chamber of electronics and telecommunications producers had requested that the three-percent duty on the import quota on telecommunications parts be lifted.
The official said the ministries would discuss the proposal this week before sending it to the cabinet and KERM.
